name: transition-hard-cut
title: Hard Cut
description: Cảnh mới hiện trọn ngay khung đầu tiên sau điểm cắt, không có khung chuyển tiếp, cắt đúng phách nhạc.

moworks.author: moworks

credit.author: Moworks Studio
credit.madeNote: the studio's own motion, written here

moworks.notes: No interpolation: the outgoing scene shows until the cut frame and the incoming scene is 100 % complete on the next frame (nothing assembles late, or it reads as loading). Cut on a beat or a word; shift the composition's weight across the cut. Demo: scene A (dark card, circle + 'A') <-> scene B (accent, square + 'B'), cut halfway through each 1.5 s half. Params: cut: điểm cắt (phách / từ) · không có duration.
